key_features.classic_presentation: ONSET: SUDDEN onset. LOCATION: Chest (pleuritic pain), often lateral or posterior. DURATION: Continuous dyspnea and pain. CHARACTER: PLEURITIC (sharp, worse with deep breath), dyspnea. AGGRAVATING: Deep inspiration, cough. RELIEVING: Shallow breathing. TIMING: Sudden onset, persistent. SEVERITY: Variable, 5-9/10 for pain. KEY POSITIVES: Dyspnea, tachycardia, tachypnea, hypoxia, unilateral leg swelling/pain (DVT), recent surgery/immobilization, hemoptysis (coughing blood). KEY NEGATIVES: NOT gradual onset, NOT reproducible with palpation.
